messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — deploy-bot flagged a bump for rwinf-service. It marks this as release-notes-only. Change window tomorrow morning. Thoughts on patch vs minor?

deploy-bot: [auto] detected: CHANGE_TYPE=docs; suggested semantic bump: patch (v1.27.2 -> v1.27.3). Proposed tag: v1.27.3. To approve, respond: `@deploy-bot approve`.

maria: If it's just docs and no API/behavior change, patch makes sense. Are we okay with releasing in change window?

sam: Agree patch is fine. Only ask: did the changelog include any consumer-visible wording that might be interpreted as behavior change?

jordan: I skimmed the note — it's purely wording and one link fix. No code changes. I'd hold off if anyone expects a hot rollback risk, but seems low.

ops: Policy refresher: release-notes-only => patch. We only consider minor when there's a backwards-incompatible or additive public API. Also, for release-note-only patches we prefer to pin deps in downstream packages to avoid accidental semver drift.

alex: OK. Two follow-ups: 1) confirm changelog snippet here so reviewers can eyeball quickly; 2) we'll do the bump in the 09:00 change window and run a quick smoke. Changelog snippet:
```
- docs: clarify config example for dedicated pools (typo fix + example link)
```

maria: looks good. I'll add the PR link to the changelog after the bump.

sam: re: pinning — should we use tilde (~) for downstream non-critical deps, or hard pin for the package that vendors the runtime? My vote: tilde for minor maintenance, hard pin only when compatibility risk.

ops: +1 tilde for downstream. For the public packages we publish, we keep caret range for libs, but services (like rwinf-service) use exact pins in CI images.

alex: Alright. I'm going to approve with `@deploy-bot approve` after we get one more ack from ops. jordan, ops — please react or say go.

jordan: go :thumbsup:

ops: go.

alex: @deploy-bot approve

deploy-bot: action: bump applied. Created tag v1.27.3 -> pushed. Opened changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rwinf-service/pull/4123. Release notes posted in #releases.

maria: nice, will add the docs link into the PR and merge after smoke.

sam: one more note for the release playbook: auto-bump for docs should default to patch unless a file in src/ or api/ changes. Filing a tiny RFC to standardize later.

alex: Sounds good — file the RFC and mention the rule in releasebot config. Thanks all. :rocket:
